Voltgrid wins a multi-year transformer order from a regional utility

Voltgrid Corp (NASDAQ: VGRD) said on Tuesday that it has been awarded a framework order by a regional utility for large power transformers, to be delivered over four years starting in 2027. The company did not disclose the order value in its announcement.

Voltgrid manufactures liquid-filled power transformers at two plants and said the order would be supplied from its existing capacity, with a planned line extension at its second plant to follow.

Utilities have been placing framework orders years ahead because lead times for large transformers have stretched past two years, according to procurement managers interviewed for this article.

A spokesperson for the utility confirmed that a framework agreement had been signed and that deliveries are scheduled to begin in the first half of 2027.
